sourceHashDefinition: SHA256 of sorted compact JSON mapping repository-relative source paths to their content SHA256; cs, csproj, ts and tsx in simulator, server, dependencies, generator and frontend source

conditions.growthSettings: source request preserved; inverse historical initialization scaling before fresh initialization
conditions.thresholdDefinition: minimum of intrinsic attachment-to-tip length / sampled target length and full blade width / sampled target width
conditions.censoring: null means not reached by the observation time; conditional medians exclude these leaves
conditions.cpuComparisonCaveat: None uses the legacy CPU light leaf approximation; BroadLeafV1 uses triangles, so this comparison includes optical geometry changes
conditions.wholeLeafDefinition: one biological leaf, never a mechanical section

fixedPopulationCaveat: 16 plants, 144 organs, 32 leaves, dimensions forced and growth frozen; initially overlapping adversarial fixture, separate concurrent validation processes; not a botanical stand or precision timing
